patthana15.12:1.1: parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na hetu na paritto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.12:2.1: hetuṃ mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na mahaggato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.12:3.1: hetuṃ appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na appamāṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
